feedback.problem:
$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}^{′}(t)=2x(t)+4y(t) \\ {y}^{′}(t)=x(t)+2y(t)\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the system of linear differential equations above. The eigenvalues of the system's matrix are ${\lambda }_{1}=0$ and ${\lambda }_{2}=4,$ for which the corresponding eigenvectors are ${v}_{1}=[-2,\text{ }1]^{T}$ and ${v}_{2}=[2,\text{ }1]^{T},$ respectively. Which of the following could represent the phase portrait of the system?

*Hint: Here, the dotted line represents the equilibrium solutions.*
feedback.worked_solution:
The general solution of the system is

$$
x(t)=[\begin{aligned}x(t) \\ y(t)\end{aligned}]={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}{e}^{4t}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

Let's now sketch the phase portrait.

- First, notice that ${x}_{E}(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ are the equilibrium solutions of the system since ${x}_{E}^{′}(t)=0.$ These solutions form the line with the equation $y=-\frac{1}{2}x$ in the phase space, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/41fff6a9cacaf140a6f86b498ba9415aef0a4699fcb119146ee49e0c98843eeb.png)

- Now, the line that passes through the origin and is parallel to ${v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ has the equation 
$y=\frac{1}{2}x$
and the straight-line solutions of the form
${c}_{2}{e}^{4t}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$
lie on that line. Since ${e}^{4t}\to \infty $ as $t\to \infty ,$ these solutions approach infinity as $t\to \infty .$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/3499c19ed90a1cbd1916878fe2b9b26401c4eedd656cb9026fbdf35e5b78acb4.png)

All other non-equilibrium solutions are parallel to the vector ${v}_{2}.$ So, the phase portrait of our system looks as follows:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/differential/14069892/assets/126db28b161fa823ae5048f79f0ed4516cf3b24053f83cbcd9bc564ae11cd3ef.png)
